cells.source:
import marimo as mo

x1 = mo.ui.slider(-2, 2, step=0.05, value=0.8, label="x₁", show_value=True)
x2 = mo.ui.slider(-2, 2, step=0.05, value=-0.6, label="x₂", show_value=True)
mo.vstack([
    mo.md("## 参数面板\n\n$f(x_1,x_2)=x_1^2+x_2^2$\n\n拖动滑杆，右侧 cell 自动更新。"),
    x1,
    x2,
])

import numpy as np
import plotly.graph_objects as go

_axis = np.linspace(-2, 2, 35)
_gx, _gy = np.meshgrid(_axis, _axis)
_height = x1.value**2 + x2.value**2
_fig = go.Figure([
    go.Surface(x=_gx, y=_gy, z=_gx**2 + _gy**2, colorscale="Blues", opacity=0.8, showscale=False),
    go.Scatter3d(x=[x1.value], y=[x2.value], z=[_height], mode="markers", marker=dict(size=7,color="#e76459")),
])
_fig.update_layout(title=f"f({x1.value:.2f}, {x2.value:.2f}) = {_height:.3f}", height=470,
                   margin=dict(l=0,r=0,t=45,b=0), scene=dict(xaxis_title="x₁",yaxis_title="x₂",zaxis_title="f"))
_fig
